name: Gia Long
role: Founding emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty
contribution: The founding emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty, the last dynasty of Vietnam, which would rule the unified territories that constitute modern-day Vietnam until 1945.
legacy: He defeated the Tây Sơn rebellion and reinstated the classical Confucian education and civil service system.
image_credit: Unknown author, restored by Nguyễn Phước Vĩnh Khánh · Public domain

checks.lead: Gia Long (Chữ Hán: 嘉隆) (Vietnamese: [zaː lawŋ] (North), [jaː lawŋ] (South); 8 February 1762 – 3 February 1820), born Nguyễn Phúc Ánh (阮福暎) or Nguyễn Ánh (阮暎), was the founding emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty, the last dynasty of Vietnam, which would rule the unified territories that constitute modern-day Vietnam until 1945.
